# DeepSeek developer change intelligence, bounded Nov 1-20 2026
The checked `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1` Hugging Face model metadata carries an MIT license label with a March 27, 2025 update; it does **not** establish a November 2026 weights launch or grant those terms to all DeepSeek models. `DeepSeek-V3` GitHub `v1.0.0` was published June 27, 2025 **for archival purposes and DOI generation**, not as a new shipped checkpoint. The newest inspected V3 repository commit, August 28, 2025, concerns kernel maintenance and is not a live API billing notice.
Decision: do not confuse archived release, model checkpoint, and hosted API terms. Current official API pricing and endpoint availability NOT_CHECKED, so no current price comparison. If local deployment is proposed, inspect the exact checkpoint LICENSE file, versioned weight hashes, inference backend, precision and memory fit, plus reproduced task quality. Without a supplied runtime target, applicability is GENERIC_ONLY. No model download, keys, private queries, installation or recurring task.
